packs.name: BioDraws
packs.credit: Images are obtained from BioDraws.com (CC BY-SA 4.0), adapted
packs.plain: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 (CC BY-SA 4.0): you may use, change and share the illustrations, also commercially, as long as you give credit, link to the license, say that changes were made, and share what you make from them under the same license.
packs.ask: If you have used illustrations from our website for your thesis, presentations, publications, or posters, please cite us by mentioning “Images are obtained from BioDraws.com.” in the figure legend.
packs.shareAlikeText: BioDraws' terms say: “If you remix, transform, or build upon the material, you must distribute your contributions under the same license as the original.” Changed icons must therefore stay under CC BY-SA 4.0, and this can extend to a figure you build with them. Many journals publish under other licenses: check your journal's terms before you use these icons in a paper.
packs.how: Put the credit in the figure legend or on the figure: Images are obtained from BioDraws.com (CC BY-SA 4.0), adapted. SiliCoDraw writes this line on the page for you.
packs.changes: Converted from SVG to SiliCoDraw's icon format: fitted into a 100 × 100 box, styles written out as attributes, text and editor data removed, coordinates rounded, and the two main colors made recolorable. The converted icons remain under CC BY-SA 4.0.

packs.name: NIH BioArt Source
packs.by: NIH BioArt Source of the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID), U.S. National Institutes of Health; every entry names its creator
packs.plain: Only entries that the site labels “Public Domain” are in this pack. Its terms say they are free for any use, including commercial use. The site gives no legal text beyond its terms page, and it expects users to respect the integrity and intended use of the illustrations. This pack is not endorsed by NIH or NIAID.
packs.ask: If the entry is licensed as "Public Domain" citation is appreciated but not required (See "How to Cite Entries in NIH BioArt Source").
packs.how: No credit is required. A credit is appreciated: “Illustration from NIAID NIH BioArt Source (bioart.niaid.nih.gov/bioart/###)”, with the entry's number (an icon's tooltip and Copy full icon credits give it). SiliCoDraw adds no credit line for these icons by itself.
packs.changes: Converted from SVG to SiliCoDraw's icon format: one color variant per entry, fitted into a 100 × 100 box, style sheets written out as attributes, text and editor data removed, coordinates rounded, and the two main colors made recolorable.
packs.each: {n}: Illustration from NIAID NIH BioArt Source ({page})

packs.name: SciDraw
packs.by: SciDraw, a community repository of scientific drawings; every drawing names its authors
packs.plain: Each drawing is under the license its author chose: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0: you may use, change and share it, also commercially, as long as you credit the author) or CC0 (public domain: no credit needed). An icon's tooltip names its license.
packs.ask: Please acknowledge the contribution of the image's authors and of SciDraw in the acknowledgements section of your work. You can use the DOI displayed below each drawing to cite the illustration properly.
packs.how: Credit every CC BY drawing you use with its authors and DOI, name SciDraw and the license, and say that it was adapted, for example: Mouse by A. Name (doi:10.5281/zenodo.0000000), scidraw.io, CC BY 4.0, adapted. SiliCoDraw writes this line on the page for you and keeps it up to date. With more than three such drawings the line names only SciDraw: then paste Copy full icon credits into the figure legend or the acknowledgments. Drawings under CC0 need no credit.
packs.changes: Converted from SVG to SiliCoDraw's icon format: fitted into a 100 × 100 box, style sheets written out as attributes, text and editor data removed, coordinates rounded, and the two main colors made recolorable.
